title: When Zero Is Competitive: A Descriptive Pilot of Transformer and Gate-Graph Surrogates on Random-Angle Quantum Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2611.19985v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We examine supervised classical prediction of all one-qubit Z and two-qubit ZZ expectation values on noiseless, layered 4-10-qubit RX/RY/RZ-CNOT circuits. In a 63-cell stratified workload with disjoint circuit-template tests, we evaluate one transformer encoder and gate-dependency graph neural networks against literal-zero and training-derived constant predictors. On the Arm K training labels, 44.89% of scalar targets have absolute magnitude below 0.05. The held-out-template zero predictor has equal-instance mean absolute error 0.193399, and none of the evaluated transformer checkpoints or final graph-network endpoints achieves a lower score. A separate product-state positive control achieves MAE 0.007755 versus 0.514811 for zero, but does not explain the failure on the entangled workload. The difference between zero and a training-fitted mean constant under training MSE is only 0.14%, a descriptive point estimate without uncertainty ana

translated_title: 当零预测具有竞争力时：Transformer与门图代理模型在随机角度量子线路上的描述性初步研究
translated_abstract: 我们考察了在无噪声、分层的4至10量子比特RX/RY/RZ-CNOT线路上，对所有单量子比特Z和双量子比特ZZ期望值进行监督式经典预测。在一个包含63个单元格的分层工作负载中，采用互不重叠的线路模板测试集，我们将一个Transformer编码器和门依赖图神经网络与字面零预测器以及基于训练数据导出的常数预测器进行了比较。在Arm K训练标签上，44.89%的标量目标绝对值低于0.05。在留出的模板上，零预测器的逐实例平均绝对误差为0.193399，而所评估的任何Transformer检查点或最终图网络端点均未取得更低的分数。一个独立的乘积态阳性对照实现了0.007755的MAE（相比之下零预测为0.514811），但这并不能解释模型在纠缠工作负载上的失败。零预测与训练拟合均值常数在训练MSE下的差异仅为0.14%，这是一个不含不确定性分析的描述性点估计。
tldr: 该描述性初步研究发现，在随机角度量子线路的期望值预测任务中，简单的零预测器（MAE 0.193399）竟能胜过所有被评估的Transformer和门依赖图神经网络代理模型，凸显了纠缠线路期望值经典预测的困难。
en_tdlr: In a descriptive pilot on random-angle quantum circuits, a trivial zero predictor (MAE 0.193399) outperformed all evaluated transformer and gate-dependency graph neural network surrogates for predicting entangled-circuit expectation values.
